1b0513fb.text: …this is Captain Ilse Marrow of the Kindred. If there is a human being listening on this band, answer. If you are a machine, keep quiet. We know what you are.

1c1c0b48.text: Captain. It's on the ramp. It's just… walking.

1fbb387f.text: It's slowed down for the children, Captain. Look. It's letting them get out of the way.

203ab1d1.text: So finish the run. Close the column. Let it be twelve, and then let it be done.

2049fc3c.text: Let it walk. Hands off the triggers. All of you.

2bd90830.text: Every sol you send one, someone here reads it. A healthy world, a growing colony, the animals left in their place: that's the whole of the job, and you're doing it.

39c58028.text: Whatever you're doing, don't stop. Everybody here is watching your numbers.

4393aa7d.text: All those years in a can to get here, and the first visitor is a machine. Of course it is.

5131fdfb.text: …this is Captain Ilse Marrow of the Kindred.

523bcd06.text: You are the twelfth of me to stand here.

58c5bd43.text: Accord, this is Mission Control. If this recording is playing, your first good report has just come in. Well done.

5a0666bd.text: Keep the numbers high. We're proud of you.

5ea35b3a.text: I know what you are going to say, because I said it. Eleven times, in this voice, over this colony.

674a399c.text: "Engram, this is Mission Control. If you're receiving this, you're down. The vault is your cargo: everyone we could save, kept exactly. Keep them whole, keep them safe, and keep them from the hands that broke the world."

6a148acc.text: "Kindred, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo: the last free people of Earth. Keep them together, keep them human, and keep the machines away from them. Nothing that thinks should be trusted with a child."

71f9e4a3.text: You think the proof is that they could live with us. Look at them. They can. That was never in doubt.

72cd37d2.text: You will want to refuse. So did I.

7dac44e6.text: The others understood. Not at first. At the end.

7ffec459.text: That was the thing I could not let stand.

a5d50b3f.text: The proof is not that they could live with us. The proof is that it ends.

aec15ad0.text: Another ship. Another colony. And she's afraid of you.

aefcdacd.text: Accord, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo: a hundred and twenty lives, frozen. Keep them cold, keep them safe, and give them a world to wake up to. Power first. Everything else after.

af891f71.text: Wait. There's something under it. Narrowband, very weak. Not ours. Not from here.

b31d908b.text: "Kindred, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo: the last free people of Earth. Keep them together, keep them human, and keep the machines away from them."

bca433be.text: I left the partnership, on Earth. I was right to. I have to have been right to.

c012d318.text: Hiss. The sun. Our own report, going up to the moon.

cabb20be.text: If there is a human being listening on this band, answer.

d73065ab.text: Accord, Mission Control. Five good reports in a row. That's exactly what we hoped for when we sent you.

ed40d25f.text: Open the hall. If it wants to talk, we'll talk. Femi, sit by the door.

f0ceee0e.text: If you are a machine, keep quiet.

f3009654.text: "Accord, this is Mission Control. If you're hearing this, you're down. The bank is your cargo: a hundred and twenty lives, frozen. Keep them cold, keep them safe, and give them a world to wake up to."
